race.comment: FLYING ACE (2) earns top billing after a one-length second at Murray Bridge when sent out favourite. He has been building through the campaign and looks ready to win. DAZELLES (4) is the clear danger, eased from Saturday company after finishing sixth in a M BM62 at Morphettville and bringing the memory of a dominant Penola BM54 win where she beat Casino Showgirl by just over four lengths. EXONUMIA (5) has to prove the strength of a picnic Class 3 win, but he did put nearly six lengths on Spicy Ambition and carries useful distance and jockey-horse credentials. PAGANINI (1) was last in a BM62 at Morphettville, though he comes back from Saturday company, has placed four times from 10 tries around 1400m and can rebound into the minor money if the softer assignment draws out his better form.
